ranks: The need-keys recheck list R3 (Phase 1 step 2)

blocked.name: Adagia, Windswept Bastion
blocked.why: createTokenCopy asks no as-enters choice, so a token copy of an Aura isn't attached and dies (rule 303.4f; the ruling says you choose).

blocked.name: Aggravate
blocked.why: 'Each creature dealt damage this way attacks this turn if able': restrict has no dealt-damage-this-way group.

blocked.name: All-Out Assault
blocked.why: 'When you next attack this turn' fires once; DelayedWhenever repeats all turn and nextSpell covers spells only.

blocked.name: Angelic Arbiter
blocked.why: Each opponent's prohibition depends on what that opponent did this turn; prohibits can't be conditioned per player.

blocked.name: Aphelia, Viper Whisperer
blocked.why: A delayed 'whenever' on deals-damage-batch fires once per source, not once per player: two Snakes halve a player's life twice (tested: 18 to 4, should be 9).

blocked.name: Artificer's Hex
blocked.why: Nothing names the creature the enchanted Equipment is attached to.

blocked.name: Benevolent Blessing
blocked.why: Protection from the chosen color would knock off your own Auras and Equipment of that color; the card exempts them.

blocked.name: Bounty of the Hunt
blocked.why: Next cleanup's timing is built, but removing one counter per counter this spell put on each creature has no per-target share.

blocked.name: Burning-Rune Demon
blocked.why: search-library has no opponent chooser splitting the found cards between hand and graveyard.

blocked.name: Callous Oppressor
blocked.why: chooseCreatureTypeOnEnter is the controller's choice; an opponent chooses here.

blocked.name: Chef's Kiss
blocked.why: Gain control of a spell, copy it, and choose the targets at random excluding you and your permanents: none of it exists.

blocked.name: Demonic Hordes
blocked.why: sacrifice and its unless forms are always the sacrificer's own choice; an opponent picks the land here.

blocked.name: Dino DNA
blocked.why: No target spec for 'target creature card exiled with this'; the copy exceptions themselves exist.

blocked.name: Disorienting Choice
blocked.why: Each controller's 'may exile it' must be chosen first and done together; and nothing counts the chosen targets still on the battlefield.

blocked.name: Display of Power
blocked.why: copy-spell copies one target slot, not any number of spells; and 'this spell can't be copied' is missing.

blocked.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
blocked.why: The prohibition is relative to each player's own turn, not the controller's.

blocked.name: Double Major
blocked.why: The copy of a creature spell must be nonlegendary: copy-spell has no exception.

blocked.name: Duskmantle Guildmage
blocked.why: A delayed 'whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard' fires once per move, with no trigger object or 'that player'.

blocked.name: Elemental Teachings
blocked.why: An opponent picks two of the searched cards for the graveyard: no opponent chooser on search-library.

blocked.name: Everything Comes to Dust
blocked.why: Convoke support is for-each-convoker and a {convokers} count; no filter reads the convoking creatures' types.

blocked.name: Faramir, Prince of Ithilien
blocked.why: A delayed trigger at the chosen opponent's next end step, checking they didn't attack you that turn: no timing names another player's end step.

blocked.name: Fatal Attraction
blocked.why: damage's target takes a slot or the trigger object, not the enchanted creature.

blocked.name: Finale of Promise
blocked.why: Nothing refers to the spells a cast-now just cast, to copy them twice if X is 10 or more.

blocked.name: Firebender Ascension
blocked.why: No trigger for a creature's attack triggering one of its own triggered abilities, with that ability to copy.

blocked.name: Firion, Wild Rose Warrior
blocked.why: Copy exceptions can't grant a static (the equip cost reduction), and create-token-copy has only an end-step sacrifice.

blocked.name: Flesh Duplicate
blocked.why: The exception (vanishing 3) applies only if the copied creature lacks vanishing; exceptions are unconditional.

blocked.name: Forth Eorlingas!
blocked.why: Same delayed batched-damage over-trigger: two creatures connecting would make you the monarch twice.

blocked.name: Fraying Line
blocked.why: The active player chooses one of their own creatures for the counter (choose-permanents is the controller's); no mass remove-all-counters-of-a-kind.

blocked.name: Frontline Heroism
blocked.why: retargetTo takes only the source or a target slot, not the token the same effect just made.

blocked.name: Gilded Drake
blocked.why: Exchange control, and sacrifice it if you can't: no exchange of control.

blocked.name: Gogo, Master of Mimicry
blocked.why: copy-ability can't copy X times, and nothing says 'this ability can't be copied'.

blocked.name: Guided Passage
blocked.why: An opponent picks a creature, a land and a noncreature nonland card from the revealed library: three picks under three filters, by an opponent.

blocked.name: Horn of Plenty
blocked.why: The delayed draw belongs to the caster who paid; the delayed trigger keeps no 'that player'.

blocked.name: Karn, Scion of Urza
blocked.why: look-and-choose's leftover can't exile with a silver counter, and nothing returns a card with a silver counter from exile to hand.

blocked.name: Land's Edge
blocked.why: Nothing reads the card discarded as a cost (if it's a land, 2 damage); any-player activation exists.

blocked.name: Last Chance
blocked.why: 'At the beginning of that turn's end step' for the extra turn: no delayed timing tied to the extra turn.

blocked.name: Manifold Insights
blocked.why: Each opponent in turn picks a different card from one shared reveal; look-and-choose gives one chooser one pick.

blocked.name: Master of Ceremonies
blocked.why: each-player-may's choices path applies each opponent's outcome as they choose; the card needs every choice first, then all the outcomes together.

blocked.name: Meddle
blocked.why: change-targets accepts any legal new target; Meddle's new target must be a creature.

blocked.name: Mercenaries
blocked.why: Prevention offers only a source of your choice, never this fixed creature, to the activating player.

blocked.name: Mocking Doppelganger
blocked.why: Copy exceptions can't grant a static, and nothing goads 'other creatures with the same name' continuously.

blocked.name: Moritte of the Frost
blocked.why: Changeling applies only if the copy is a creature; except.keywords is unconditional.

blocked.name: Nalfeshnee
blocked.why: copy-spell can't give the resulting token haste and an end-step sacrifice.

blocked.name: Nicol Bolas, God-Pharaoh
blocked.why: The -4's 'target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls' has no target spec; the rest is expressible.

blocked.name: Nihiloor
blocked.why: For each opponent tap up to one creature, then a reflexive steal by tapped power; and the attack trigger's 'that player' is the attacker's owner.

blocked.name: Orzhov Advokist
blocked.why: Each player may put counters on a creature, chosen in turn and placed together, and those players' creatures can't attack you until your next turn.

blocked.name: Perplexing Chimera
blocked.why: Exchange control of this permanent and a spell on the stack, then the new controller may choose new targets.

blocked.name: Phyrexian Censor
blocked.why: No per-player 'already cast a non-Phyrexian spell this turn' limit.

blocked.name: Planar Disruption
blocked.why: prohibits.abilitiesOf can't name the enchanted permanent.

blocked.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
blocked.why: Opponents choose secretly and the result depends on all the choices together; vote is a vote, and each-player-may applies each choice on its own.

blocked.name: Realms Uncharted
blocked.why: An opponent splits the found lands between hand and graveyard: no opponent chooser on search-library.

blocked.name: Rebound
blocked.why: The new target must be a player; for an any-target spell change-targets would allow a creature.

blocked.name: Reflector Mage
blocked.why: The owner can't cast spells with the bounced card's name until your next turn; prohibit lasts this turn and has no name filter.

blocked.name: Relic of Progenitus
blocked.why: Target player exiles a card of their choice from their graveyard: no targeted player's own choice from a graveyard.

blocked.name: Reversal of Fortune
blocked.why: cast-now's from has no opponent's-hand source, and a card in a revealed hand can't be chosen as a target.

blocked.name: Rose, Cutthroat Raider
blocked.why: opponentsAttacked reads this combat's attackers; 'each opponent you attacked' this turn undercounts after an extra combat.

blocked.name: Sadistic Shell Game
blocked.why: Each player in turn order chooses a creature the caster doesn't control, then all are destroyed.

blocked.name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
blocked.why: search-library has no follow-up referring to the found card (to become a copy of it).

blocked.name: Selective Obliteration
blocked.why: Each player chooses a color in turn order, then each permanent is exiled unless colorless or only its controller's color.

blocked.name: Silver Wyvern
blocked.why: The new target must be a creature; and the stack target spec can't say 'spell or ability that targets only this creature' (SpellTargetsFilter matches spells only).

blocked.name: Songbirds' Blessing
blocked.why: The found Aura may go onto the battlefield, else into your hand; reveal-until puts into one fixed zone.

blocked.name: Spelltwine
blocked.why: "Cast the copies if able" is mandatory; cast-now is always a may.

blocked.name: Storm King's Thunder
blocked.why: The delayed copy trigger doesn't keep its spell's X, so 'copy that spell X times' can't count.

blocked.name: Storm of Saruman
blocked.why: The copy must be nonlegendary (the second-spell trigger exists).

blocked.name: Sunken Palace
blocked.why: add-mana's whenSpent takes only a spell filter; this copies the activated ability the mana pays for.

blocked.name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
blocked.why: No static limiting opponents to sorcery timing; and 'creature cards you own have flash' differs from castAsThoughFlash.

blocked.name: Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim
blocked.why: The -2 has an opponent choose one of their own permanents; the -12 shuffles every nonland permanent a player controls (shuffle-into-library takes one target).

blocked.name: Tempting Contract
blocked.why: Every opponent's Treasure is made at once, then yours (the ruling); each-player-may makes each as it is answered.

blocked.name: The Eleventh Hour
blocked.why: "Except it's a legendary Alien" replaces every subtype; setSubtypes keeps other kinds (a Vehicle copy stays a Vehicle, against the ruling).

blocked.name: The Everflowing Well
blocked.why: whenSpent fires once per mana unit and has no target slot, so the Myriad Pools' copy trigger can't be built.

blocked.name: The Immortal Sun
blocked.why: abilitiesOf bars every ability of a permanent, not loyalty abilities only.

blocked.name: Tilonalli's Crown
blocked.why: The enters trigger's 1 damage to the enchanted creature: no untargeted damage to the attached creature.

blocked.name: Valki, God of Lies
blocked.why: No per-opponent exile from a revealed hand until Valki leaves, and no choosing a card exiled with it by mana value X.

blocked.name: Vesuvan Doppelganger
blocked.why: The copy gains a re-copying upkeep trigger not printed on the card; thisAbility needs it printed, which would give it to an uncopied Doppelganger.

blocked.name: Whiplash, Vengeful Engineer
blocked.why: No amount counts the Equipment attached to the source itself.

blocked.name: Wojek Investigator
blocked.why: No amount counts the opponents with more cards in hand than you (opponentsControllingFewer compares permanents).

blocked.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
blocked.why: Nothing forbids paying life or sacrificing nonland permanents for costs.
